title: German Lettuce Salad with Grapes: Oma's Kopfsalat mit Weintrauben.
ldName: German Lettuce Salad with Grapes: Oma's Kopfsalat mit Weintrauben
ldIngredientsRaw: ¼ pound each of blue and green grapes, sliced (preferably seedless)
1 red apple, quartered, cored, thinly sliced
¼ pound cheese, thinly sliced and broken into bits (preferably Emmental)
ldInstructionsRaw: In serving bowl, mix vinegar, oil, salt, pepper, and sugar to make salad dressing.
Add all the other ingredients and toss gently.
